groups.title: EPC Projects
groups.summary: Engineering, procurement and construction run as six concurrent silos rather than three.
groups.intro: Our EPC team's objective is to deliver your project safely, with exceptional quality at the best price, generating revenue for your company as early as possible. Engineering and procurement activities are organized around the needs of construction, and constructability is brought in early, where it has its greatest effect. We excel on fast track projects.
groups.imageAlt: Refinery towers and a tall crane under an orange sky

Mechanical completion and commissioning combined to cut redundant resources
Work to economical design standards, with reaction time built in for construction

groups.title: Construction and Fabrication
groups.summary: Direct hire craft, four fabrication shops, and the electrical, instrumentation and thermal work that goes with them.

We emphasize pre-assembly and modularization to reduce on-site man hours, and offer turnkey completion including documentation, testing, x-ray and stress relieving where required.

about.title: We are your Alliance.
text: Alliance Industrial Group, founded in 1987, is a Gulf Coast-based EPC specializing in site preparation, heavy civil construction, specialty welding, piping, mechanical services, structural steel, equipment installation and demo, exchangers, boilers, furnaces, vessels and towers, tank repair, sheet metal, instrumentation and electrical, and project controls.

Alliance Industrial Group, in conjunction with SMW Projects, has earned the respect of the industry by focusing on empowering our customers to do more in less time through cost-savings approaches. With over 40 years of experience across all specialized fields of the industrial sector, we pursue a concentration on safety and quality for the sake of our customer and for the confidence of our team.

The company has grown organically on its reputation for safety and quality, innovation, and the ability to manage and execute work to maximize cost savings to our clients. We work with our customers to forge an alliance, and we are proud to call these clients our own.

facts.heading: Free consultation
facts.text: Plan your next project with Alliance and get a free consultation. Call 1.832.932.9249 or fill out the contact form, and one of our representatives will contact you shortly.

facts.heading: How we define the job
facts.text: Your project, our expertise, from cradle to grave: our mission critical belief is that we are in one business, the Results Business. We define project completion as on-time startup, with systems and processes oriented towards providing the owner with control of the project.
